description: Find up to 20 evidence routes using keywords in reviewed question variants and worked-example titles, such as exact output speedup, Notion Slack permissions, audit export coverage or signing certificate. Returns the matched wording and original scoped question for preview_evidence_answer. Case, punctuation and common question words are ignored; no semantic inference is performed. A match suggests evidence to inspect, not proof that it applies to a new claim. Free and read-only.
name: find_evidence_questions
title: Find published evidence questions
